findings.description: Critical: `RoutingService._current_exploration_budget` reads `summary["exploration_entries"]` to compute `pct_used`, but `LedgerService.usage_summary` never emits `exploration_entries` (only `exploration_usd_used` / `entries`). With defaults `ROUTING_EXPLORATION_PCT=0.10` and `ROUTING_EXPLORATION_MONTHLY_USD=0` (USD ceiling disabled), `pct_used` stays 0.0 forever, so the dual-ceiling gate never exhausts and Round-1 exploration-budget remediation remains incomplete in production.
findings.resolution: In `usage_summary`, add `exploration_entries: sum(1 for row in selected if row.get("exploration"))` (and cover it in `test_usage_summary_aggregates_by_model_and_exploration_spend`). Prefer an integration test that drives `RoutingService.select_model` against a real `LedgerService` mock return without injecting `exploration_entries` by hand.
findings.existing_code:
+            "by_model": by_model,
+            "exploration_usd_used": sum(
+                float(row.get("actual_usd") or 0.0) for row in selected if row.get("exploration")
+            ),

findings.description: Critical: `OpenRouterRefresher._entry` now returns a plain dict with `refreshed_at` as a live `datetime`, skipping `CatalogEntry.to_row()`'s isoformat conversion. `SupabaseClient.insert/update` pass `json=data` to httpx, which cannot serialize `datetime` (`TypeError: Object of type datetime is not JSON serializable`), so scheduled catalog refresh fails on the REST backend after this remediation.
findings.resolution: Normalize `refreshed_at` (and any other timestamps) to ISO-8601 strings before upsert, matching the prior `CatalogEntry.to_row()` contract; keep omitting unset latency/quota fields so the null-wipe fix is preserved.
findings.existing_code:
+        entry: dict[str, Any] = {
+            "vendor": vendor,
+            "model": model_id,
+            "endpoint_kind": "openrouter",
+            "base_url": "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1",
+            "available": True,
+            "refreshed_at": refreshed_at,
+            "stale": False,
+        }

findings.description: Critical: `LedgerService.usage_summary` now runs `occurred_at` bounds through `encode_filter_value`, turning UTC offsets like `+00:00` into `%2B00:00`. `DirectPostgresClient.query` splits on `&` then coerces gte/lte values via `_coerce_filter_value` without `_decode_query_value`, so `datetime.fromisoformat` rejects the encoded stamp and the timestamptz bind fails. Because every `select_model` call now awaits `_current_exploration_budget` → `usage_summary`, adaptive selection breaks on the direct-Postgres path.
findings.resolution: Decode percent-encoded filter values in `DirectPostgresClient` before `_coerce_filter_value` for eq/gte/lte/gt (same as the existing `=cs.` path), or stop encoding `+` for values that only the Postgres splitter consumes. Add a ledger/query test that round-trips an aware UTC `occurred_at` bound through encode + DirectPostgres parsing.
